Subject: Deal capacity scenario sprint plan

Team,

I pulled together the first pass of capacity scenarios tied to the Q2 pipeline — attached is "capacity-scenarios-2028Q2.xlsx" (tabbed by deal, start date, and requested commit).

Goal: agree on a sprinted decision window (this week) so Infra can start provisional reservations and Finance can align on commitment thresholds. High-level asks:
- Sales: confirm start dates and committed slot numbers per deal (highlighted column).
- Infra: confirm whether the requested reserve profile (40% sustained, 60% burst) is feasible for the proposed start weeks and the expected GPU families.
- Finance: indicate whether we need an MOP (mutual action plan)/billing cadence for deals > $200k ARR.

Proposed cadence: quick sync Wed 14th 10am PT; if blockers persist, we escalate to Jordan/LA for approval.

Attachments: capacity-scenarios-2028Q2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park

Subject: Re: Deal capacity scenario sprint plan

Kimberly — thanks for pulling this together. Quick sanity checks from infra:

1) GPU family: The spreadsheet assumes A100/80GB for the sustained reserve rows. For the burst windows, are teams expecting T4/RTX or temporary A100 burst? If it's mixed, we need to itemize per-deal GPU family so we can map to available pools.

2) Reservation lead time: our typical procurement-to-rollout for new dedicated pools is ~3 weeks (provisioning + validation). If any deals need start < 3 weeks, we either use existing burst capacity or apply region fallbacks.

3) Safety margin: recommend we provision a 25% safety buffer for Week-of-start for all reserved commitments in the spreadsheet; we can tune down once billing/commit is signed.

Attached: gpu-profile-matrix.pdf (infrastructure GPU mapping and perf delta by model family).

Subject: Re: Deal capacity scenario sprint plan — Acme / other commitments

Appreciate the quick pull, Kim. A few inputs from Sales (deal-level):

- Acme Analytics (DEAL-4582): asking for 60 reserved slots A100-equivalent, start week of 2028-04-02. Sales is prepared to sign a 12-month reserved commitment at 80% utilization guarantee. Procurement wants MAP before Q-end. HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/4582
- BetaCloud Inc (DEAL-4610): smaller pilot, 10 reserved slots, start 2028-03-28, needs burst availability for big experiments in April.
- DeltaHealth (DEAL-4622): tentative; wants delayed start until May pending PII scoping; treat as optional for now.

Ask to Finance: can we accept a 6-month ramp MOP with monthly billing for pilots <$50k? If not, we should flag pilots separately to avoid reserving dedicated fleet for short pilots.

Infra — based on Marcus's note, the A100 pool has 120 slots across us-west and us-east; we can commit 60 for Acme if we adjust safety margin to 20% and use burst fallback in us-east for projected April spikes.

I can surface MAP language for Acme if Procurement wants it; attaching a short draft is helpful.

Subject: Re: Deal capacity scenario sprint plan — decisions and next steps

Thanks all — good alignment. Summary and action items: 

Decisions:
- Acme (DEAL-4582): commit 60 A100-equivalent reserved slots starting 2028-04-02 with 12-month term. Finance and Procurement will proceed with MAP and monthly billing cadence for the first quarter.
- BetaCloud (DEAL-4610): 10 reserved slots pilot starting 2028-03-28; pilot will not consume dedicated pool beyond agreed burst windows.
- DeltaHealth (DEAL-4622): leave optional; will not reserve capacity now.

Action items (owners / dates):
- Laura Bennett: finalize MAP billing cadence for Acme, confirm billing terms by Mon 2028-03-20.
- Marcus Lin: provision provisional reservation of 60 A100-equivalent slots (apply 20% safety margin) and validate fallback in us-east by 2028-03-28.
- Vivek Kulkarni: get signed MAP and send to procureops@acme-analytics.com; target 2028-03-21.
- Jordan Blake: if any infra constraints show >2 week lead time, escalate to execs by 2028-03-22.

Attachments to this thread: finalized-reserve-mop.xlsx, MAP-Acme-4582.pdf

If everyone is good, Marcus — please mark the reservation as provisional in the fleet booking sheet and ping here once slots are reserved.

Best,
Kim
